scripts.verify:marion-admin-e2e: node --check index.js && node --check Data/marion/runtime/marionBridge.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const i=fs.readFileSync('index.js','utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('Data/marion/runtime/marionBridge.js','utf8');if(!i.includes('MARION_ADMIN_EXACT_RESPONSE_IDENTITY_HARDLOCK_V2_START')||!b.includes('MARION_PRIVATE_EXACT_RESPONSE_IDENTITY_HARDLOCK_V10_START')||!i.includes('MARION_ADMIN_SUBSTANTIVE_RESPONSE_HARDLOCK_V3_START')||!b.includes('MARION_PRIVATE_SUBSTANTIVE_RESPONSE_HARDLOCK_V12_START'))process.exit(1);" && npm run test:marion-substantive-response-contract && npm run test:marion-admin-e2e-contract
scripts.test:marion-substantive-response-contrac: node -e "const b=require('./Data/marion/runtime/marionBridge.js');const input={prompt:'In two sentences, explain what you can help me accomplish as my private administrative assistant.',sessionId:'contract-test',privateAdminConversation:true,marionAdminConversation:true,directMarionAdminInterface:true,authenticatedOperator:true,adminVerified:true,serverSideAdminAuth:true,scope:'private_admin'};Promise.resolve(b.handleMarionAdminConversation(input)).then(o=>{const r=String(o&&o.reply||'');if(!o||o.ok!==true||o.publicAgent!=='Nyx'||o.surfaceAgent!=='Marion'||o.authority!=='Marion'||!/analyze information/i.test(r)||/hang tight|hold on a moment|signal from the noise|safest next move/i.test(r))process.exit(1);console.log('Marion substantive response contract: PASS')}).catch(()=>process.exit(1));"
scripts.check:nyx-tts-entry: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const file='utils/tts.js';if(!fs.existsSync(file)){console.error('Canonical Nyx TTS authority file not found: '+file);process.exit(1);}console.log('Nyx TTS authority: '+file);const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',file],{stdio:'inherit'});if(result.error){console.error(result.error.message);process.exit(1);}process.exit(Number.isInteger(result.status)?result.status:1);"
